objective: Exploratory temporal model adequacy on previously seen observed GeoNet reconstruction; no physical mechanism or power inference.

api.training: fit_training(times, excess, train_end, T0, protocol_search, deadline, progress_callback=None)
api.scoring: evaluate_window(times, excess, record, start, end, T0, beta, order=16)
api.controls: selected_controls(times, excess, record, start, end, T0, beta, tolerance=1e-4)
api.pure_guard: validate_fit(payload, search=None); defaults to frozen interface search, runner supplies actual protocol search

starts.shared: each matched ML/ratio's selected successful null(a,d,n) plus eta=0 then eta=0.2; exact matching-null floor retained
starts.continuous_omori: per ratio: that ratio's coarse winner(a,d,n,log(c),p), then(a_seed,0,.35,log(.01),1.1), then(a_seed-.5,.1,.7,log(1),2.5); retain coarse winner floor

interface.mandatory_success: all 137 prescribed start slots must have a successful accepted solver lineage; failed raw returns remain ineligible and retained; unresolved/censored slot stops for review; no post-outcome grid fallback

uniform_failure_only_recovery.basis: prospective amendment from synthetic-only boundary line-search failure before new observed outcomes
uniform_failure_only_recovery.tier0: L-BFGS-B original prescribed start, optimizer options in search
uniform_failure_only_recovery.tier1: only if tier0 unaccepted: L-BFGS-B same original start and bounds, same options except maxls200
uniform_failure_only_recovery.tier2: only if tier1 unaccepted: bounded Powell same original start/bounds, maxiter2000,maxfev100000,xtol1e-6,ftol1e-10
uniform_failure_only_recovery.acceptance: solver.success AND finite feasible point AND fresh objective within1e-4 of solver value AND fresh control within1e-4 AND objective<=own original-start objective+1e-8; selected recovery point rechecked with fresh order32 geometry; continuousOmori independently checked through fixed-kernel route
uniform_failure_only_recovery.provenance: retain every raw attempt with method/options/start/return/status/acceptance/elapsed; only accepted return eligible, all prescribed slots must resolve

interface.likelihood: full predictable ground likelihood plus training-beta exponential mark density; beta frozen in test; normalized productivity (1-ratio)*exp(beta*ratio*excess)
interface.geometry: global z(t)=2*t/24394-1; empty initial history at0; full pre-window history retained; event intensity excludes itself; test events update history only after event
interface.residual_scope: first interval included; final no-event interval saved as censored compensator, excluded from Exp/Uniform event-gap samples; realized compensator mass is not origin-conditional expected count
interface.scope: all observed data previously seen; exploratory predictive adequacy; no mechanism, completeness, power, fitted-KS or naive Poisson-count claims
interface.budget: parent runner cooperative deadline, 1800s maximum through fits, selected controls and residual assembly; any hard wall containment belongs to an outer owned-process supervisor

training: Strict prefix, beta from training marks alone and common across families, original absolute x=2t/T0-1; finite search and bounded local solvers, no global optimality claim.
scoring: Full predictable conditional ground and common mark loglikelihood, all earlier history, random count, full compensator and terminal censored exposure.
failure_policy: Every prescribed slot must have accepted successful lineage; retain all failed raw attempts. Stop on first unresolved search/control/resource issue. No partial estimator or post-outcome grid reduction.
effect_scope: Predictive preference is not physical identification; all histories/families previously inspected, exploratory only.
historical_protocol_qualification: Current iteration5 protocol differs from old execution hash. Separately preserved reconstructed version matches, but was not a contemporaneous immutable launch snapshot. This new protocol is independently frozen.

public_distribution_adaptation.scope: Only interpreter discovery in two optional PowerShell launchers is adapted. All scientific parameters, grids, starts, algorithms, budgets, failure rules and numerical source bytes are unchanged. Original source pins retained in provenance/historical_observed_protocol.json. No scientific run performed.
public_distribution_adaptation.inherited_status: The original freeze status concerns the inherited scientific design, not a new public-preparation scientific execution.
